# Lazyskills Docs



Lazyskills is a terminal UI for browsing and managing reusable AI coding skills.

Quick Start [#quick-start]

1. Install dependencies for this repository.
2. Run `just docs-sync` to generate fresh reference pages from Rust source comments.
3. Run `just docs` and open `/docs`.

Core Sections [#core-sections]

* `getting-started`: first-run setup and local development.
* `core`: architecture and workflow design details.
* `reference`: generated API and module docs.


# Architecture



Runtime Layers [#runtime-layers]

Lazyskills organizes logic into app, features, services, and adapters.

Feature Model [#feature-model]

* Feature state lives in `src/features/**/state.rs`.
* Feature logic lives in `src/features/**/logic.rs`.
* Rendering logic lives in `src/features/**/render.rs` where needed.

Service Model [#service-model]

Services collect filesystem and external-command interactions used by multiple features.

Reference Generation [#reference-generation]

Generated reference pages are written under `docs/content/docs/reference` from public Rust docs.


# Common Commands



Development [#development]

* `just dev` runs the terminal UI locally.
* `just check` compiles the Rust project without building release artifacts.

Documentation [#documentation]

* `just docs` starts the docs application from `docs/`.
* `just docs-sync` regenerates the reference pages from Rust source comments.
* `just docs-sync-check` fails when generated pages are stale.
* `just docs-gh-pub` exports and publishes static docs to `gh-pages`.


# Installation



Requirements [#requirements]

* Rust toolchain installed
* `just` command available
* `bun` available for docs tasks

Install [#install]

```bash
cargo install --path .
```

Verify [#verify]

```bash
lazyskills --help
```
